CNQ.TO.title: Horizon tailings penalty upheld
CNQ.TO.summary: The Alberta Energy Regulator upheld a CAD 278,000 penalty for failing to store a hazardous substance in a way that prevented animal contact. The ruling documents bird deaths in 2022.

ENB.TO.source: Canada Energy Regulator · Canada’s Pipeline System 2026
ENB.TO.title: Line 5 environmental review and Indigenous land dispute
ENB.TO.summary: The Canada Energy Regulator reported that an appeals court allowed the pipeline to continue operating and sent the case back to a lower court. It also reported that Michigan required a broader environmental review of the tunnel permit.

XOM.source: U.S. Department of Justice · Joliet refinery
XOM.title: Historical air pollution compliance case at Joliet refinery
XOM.summary: The U.S. Department of Justice announced a consent decree amendment addressing violations of the Clean Air Act and an earlier decree. It included about USD 1.52 million in penalties and emissions control upgrades.

TD.TO.source: U.S. Department of Justice · TD Bank plea
TD.TO.title: Anti-money laundering case involving U.S. subsidiary
TD.TO.summary: TD Bank N.A. and its U.S. holding company pleaded guilty to related charges. The case raises material concerns about internal controls and compliance.

MSFT.title: Reported total emissions exceeded the 2020 baseline
MSFT.summary: Microsoft reported that total Scope 1–3 emissions in FY24 increased 23.4% from the 2020 baseline, with Scope 3 emissions up 26%. These historical figures come from the company.

AAPL.title: Reported emissions reductions since 2015
AAPL.summary: In its 2024 announcement, Apple reported that greenhouse gas emissions had fallen more than 55% from the 2015 baseline.
